description: This file defines an interface for transaction management extensions within Orleans, including methods for preparing, committing, and pinging transactions.

classes.name: ITransactionManagerExtension
classes.description: An interface extending IGrainExtension for managing transactions, including preparation, commitment, and ping methods.

methods.name: PrepareAndCommit
methods.description: Prepares and commits a transaction with specified resources and participants.

methods.name: Prepared
methods.description: Informs that a participant has prepared or completed a transaction phase.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Pings the transaction participant or resource to check connectivity or health.
